instagramAd.headline: Printer rental that keeps Pasig offices moving.
instagramAd.body: Predictable monthly setup, clear support messaging, and a more credible local offer for decision-makers.

videoStoryboard.copy: Open with the common office issue: printing problems slow down Pasig teams.
Show the rental model as a simpler operations decision, not just a hardware purchase.
Highlight dependable support, uptime, and easy monthly planning.
Ground the message in Pasig office use cases and buyer reality.
End with the CTA: Request a quick rental recommendation.

summary: The creative agent packages the campaign into one coherent visual direction, a ready-to-review Instagram ad concept, and a five-scene video outline. This keeps later copy and distribution work aligned to the same offer.
